name: Pilgrim’s Passage (General)
body:
I have travelled to the four Great Cathedrals, and worn the Chains of Penance at each; that counts for something.

Prerequisite(s): 1st level character, Knowledge (religion) 1 rank

Benefit(s): You gain an additional point of healing per character level when positive energy is channeled or a cure spell is cast upon you, and +2 sacred bonus to Diplomacy checks with divine spellcasters of your alignment.
